_about: Facts: Shopping Mall Sample 2's real category scores, in risk-quality.service.ts riskQualityFacts wording. The gateway's rule gives 84.3 / 85.7 where Marsh shows 83.0 / 86.8; Marsh's comments quote neither. Observations: mall2-1 to mall2-7 and the OFI case's from Mall 2; mall2-s4-* written from its Sections 6-11.
name: Shopping Mall Sample 2, section 4 Risk Quality Ratings and Comments
source: Shopping Mall Sample 2 - PRE 2025 - REDACTED.pdf, Section 4 (pp. 13-14)

observations.note: mall opened 2009. bsmt link to MRT + links to nbr malls. site 21,731m2, GFA 125,621m2, NLA 58,340m2. residences ~35,000m2 GFA
mostly RC cols/beams/slabs, some steel w sprayed fireproofing. RC flat roof. partitions drywall or lightweight conc panels
mall ext RC or glass on steel frame, freeform curved glass + metal facade. residences RC / curtain glass on steel. nothing combustible seen
retail L1-L5 all open to each other thru the voids - basically 1 compartment
ok so in the basements the atriums and the escalator voids have the two hour fabric shutters, they drop on fire alarm, so each basement level is its own compartment except the utility rooms
4hr roller shutters at all MRT entrances + links to nbr malls. residences access separated from retail by brick wall - site team not sure if fire rated
HT/LT sw rms + tx rms - 2hr rated doors
hot work permit form reviewed - no fire watch requirement during or after hot work
no formal FP system impairment programme. isolations approved by tech service team only, no impairment permit
concealed spk cover plates painted over in retail corridor
FA panel showed 2 faults on arrival, both cleared during visit, fault log updated
loading bay cardboard waste removed daily, area clear at time of visit
wet spk B4-L8 OH3 + L55-56 OH1 to CP52. not in elec rms / risers - smoke det there instead. tenant areas spk in room + ceiling void
2 spk pump sets, duty/standby/jockey all elec, on genset backup. PSB listed. tanks L6 126 m3 SS, L55 77 m3 RC. pump flow test not seen - water proving test yearly for fire cert, no issues per FM
addressable FA panel in FCC, manned 24/7, DECAM by Chubb. smoke dets in all elec rms, risers, LMRs. beam dets L4 atrium voids. MCPs + bells throughout
kitchen hoods wet chemical, tenant maintained, not linked to main FA. tenants clean filters quarterly; common exhaust ducts cleaned yearly by FM contractor
Chubb service contract for FP. monthly pump run, monthly smoke det test (100%), monthly roller shutter test, annual flow switch test
2 incoming 22kV feeders. 10 silicon oil tx, ~25-30% load, L2 units back each other up, L8 units back each other up. IR thermography + PD test + DGA yearly by LEW contractor
2 diesel gensets L8, 1000 L day tank each, no bulk tank. monthly no-load test in-house, annual load test
chillers 5 x 1000RT + 2 x 500RT, 3 x 1000RT run day, peak 2400-2600RT. spare capacity
housekeeping generally good most areas seen
boundary exposures light - nbr malls + MRT 10m, via underground links. lightning moderate, LPS installed. flood low - sump pumps, flood barriers + sensors at link, tested yearly w PUB
~500 CCTV incl 10 PTZ, 45 days recording, video analytics. guards 3 shifts in-house + Prosegur. pump + tx rooms lock and key + RFID
ERP for fire, bomb, pandemic. 6-man ERT. MOC involves stakeholders + risk assessment

reference:
Risk Quality Rating Comments

Positive Points
The positive points which comes out from the visit are following:
- Buildings were constructed of fire resistive construction materials
- The retail mall is provided with automatic sprinkler system and the entire building is
provided with a fire alarm system.
- Preventive maintenance programmes are in place for fire protection and detection
equipment.
- Good redundancy is available for critical utilities.
- Good housekeeping observed for most areas visited.
